preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100,000.
The time A when Chef's girlfriend arrives must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The burn time Y of a candle must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The number of candles X that can be lit at once must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum number of lit candles at time A.
